Open the offline game

Local preview. Export your progress from Save & settings before closing, then import the code to continue.

1 · Make a plan before the fight

Keep a living front-row cat to cover the rear. Inspect enemy names, rows and the next signature. Choose Finish, Support or Leader focus, then Steady or Protect care. Two distinct cats activate a crew job: two marks give its small effect; four replace it with the full effect.

During battle, controls are speed, pause, skip and camera. Full unlocked skill kits act automatically; ultimates use a fixed opening delay and cooldown. The result explains observed protection, healing, target choices and gear triggers.

2 · Build a coherent set

Four slots: utensil, apron, clasp and keepsake. Eight sets offer two-piece and four-piece behaviors. Compare a piece in your current build to see stats, thresholds gained or lost, transfers and utility. The power score is an approximate build estimate, not a win probability.

RarityMain-stat multiplierRole identity

Rare1.25×One compatible affix
Epic1.50×Two compatible affixes
Legendary1.75×Three affixes and a bounded unique behavior

Enhance up to +12 without a failure roll, reforge one compatible affix, tailor a chosen template, and salvage spare gear. The 240-piece shelf is shared across reward sources. Three saved shifts store crew, rows, plan and exact equipment instances; missing items prevent partial application.

Pack the pantry between encounters

Milk restores missing HP immediately. The other four supplies reserve one item for one companion in the next encounter. Changing or cancelling that reservation returns the unspent item. Prepare it before opening the encounter; there is no in-fight supply button.

3 · Earn an invitation, keep a choice

Standard, featured and equipment banners use earned stamps: 150 per invitation. The odds drawer is one click away and shows conditional odds for the next pull, including pity. Legendary base chance is 1%; soft pity begins at pull 41 and hard pity guarantees one at 60. A featured miss guarantees the next Legendary is featured.

BannerCommonRareEpicLegendary
Cafe Guestbook60%30%9%1%
Marigold at Closing Time60%30%9%1%
Mending Basket55%34%10%1%

These are starting probabilities. The conditional Legendary chance rises by 3 percentage points per pull after 40 draws without one, with a guarantee on draw 60.

Every paid earned-currency invitation grants one selector mark. Sixty marks choose a companion or eligible gear. The welcome invitation grants no marks. Marks do not expire and choosing a reward does not reset pity. Duplicate companions become shards. There is no purchase button.

4 · Return to a working cafe

Today’s board uses the existing daily and weekly quests. Cafe service accrues from elapsed time, allows two services per UTC day and counts at most eight hours away. Skipped dates do not stack rewards. A clock watermark prevents rollback claims.

The collection journal remembers first ownership after salvage, completed sets and rewarded routes. Milestones can be claimed once; a full daily allowance preserves a pending claim. One ordered lesson at a time introduces the next system, and returning players can move on.

5 · Choose your next table

Three chapters offer routes with ordinary battles, elites, events, shops, treasures and campfires. Route points pay for temporary rewards; a campfire restores the crew. Between encounters, compare the next opponents with your remaining HP and packed supply. Daily challenge and Tower add alternate routes, with progress shown at the cafe.

A route locks its challenge band when it starts. Enemies do not become stronger just because you equip an item. Bosses change phase once at half HP. When the boss falls, its linked helpers leave at the action boundary. Read the result observations to see which shields, heals and target choices mattered.

At most one reservation per account, edition and season, and one reservation per UTC day. Burns never reopen supply; two Moon records from different seasons can become a cosmetic badge. Editions add zero combat stats.

Design only — not minted. The replayable issuance ledger enforces limits within this local save. It is not global enforcement across copied saves. The existing Fuji Relic bridge remains separate; no on-chain launch is included.
